title: Store Pickup Standard for Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders
content:
Store Operations standard for Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders collected at a store. It sets, per fulfillment method, when a pickup order is promised ready, how long a ready order is held and what may change while it waits.

| Term | Standard Ship-to-Home | Expedited Ship-to-Home | Buy Online Pick Up In Store | Curbside Pickup | Same-Day Delivery | Large Item Freight Delivery |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Hours after placement by which a pickup order is promised ready | 0 | 0 | 2 | 2 | 0 | 0 |
| Calendar days a ready order is held before it is cancelled and refunded | 0 | 0 | 7 | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| One-time extension of the hold available on request (days) | 0 | 0 | 3 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Government photo ID matching the order name or the named alternate person required at pickup | No | No | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| One alternate pickup person may be named on the order | No | No | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Pickup store may be changed before the order is ready | No | No | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| A ready-for-pickup order may still be cancelled by the customer | No | No | Yes | Yes | No | No |

### Notes on the standard

- The hold is counted in calendar days; the extension is a one-time addition the customer may ask for, in days.
- Buy Online Pick Up In Store holds a ready order 7 days and offers a 3-day extension; Curbside Pickup holds 3 days and offers no extension (0 days).
- Both pickup methods are promised ready 2 hours after placement, require photo ID at handover, allow one alternate pickup person, allow a change of pickup store before the order is ready, and allow the customer to cancel while the order is ready for pickup.
- The delivery methods carry 0 or No on every pickup term.
